subtitulo: Hoy me levanté temprano. Últimamente he dormido mal.
regla: In Mexico the preterite is the default for any finished action, even one from today: hoy desayuné chilaquiles. The present perfect is for a past that's still open, still going on up to now: últimamente he dormido mal, nunca he tenido problemas.

bloques.texto: **Preterite** (**comí, fui**): the default for **finished** actions, with any time word: **ayer**, **el año pasado**, and also **hoy**, **esta mañana**, **esta semana**.
**Present perfect** (**he comido, he ido**): the action is **not closed**. It has been happening up to now and may continue.

filas: El sábado fui a la playa.
Hasta ahora he ido tres veces.

bloques.texto: With finished times (**ayer, anoche, el lunes, en 2020, hace dos días**) only the preterite works.
With open periods (**este año, últimamente, hasta ahora, nunca**) the perfect stresses that it's still going on. The preterite is also common there in Mexico.
**Hoy he desayunado a las siete** isn't wrong, but in Mexico a finished action from today sounds more natural in the preterite: **Hoy desayuné a las siete.**
Tip: when in doubt in Mexico, use the preterite. Choose the perfect only when the story isn't over.

lista.en: Today I got up early to go surfing.
Last night we watched two episodes of The Expanse.

lista.es: Mi papá ==trabajó== en San Diego en 2015.
lista.en: My dad worked in San Diego in 2015.
It's been very hot this month.
So far we've harvested ten squash.

lista.es: Nunca ==he tenido== problemas con mis vecinos.
lista.en: I've never had problems with my neighbors.

filas.t: Ayer he ido a la playa.
Hace dos días he comido birria.
En 2015 mi papá ha trabajado en San Diego.
En 2015 mi papá trabajó en San Diego.

lista.texto: The forms: [[5267|regular -ar verbs in the present perfect]], [[5588|-er and -ir verbs]].
The default past: [[6004|the preterite for completed actions]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish (Mexico): _This morning I drank coffee._
In Spanish, with the perfect (it's still going on): _Lately I've worked a lot._
Fix it: _Ayer he visto a Juan._
